morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的人名，整词记忆，不作马来语词根和词缀拆分。通常读 /ˈwɛs.li/，也有 /ˈwɛz.li/；具体人物以本人读法为准。输入未提供爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 韦斯利：英语来源的人名，常用作男性的名字。
senses.en_definition: Wesley, an English-origin personal name commonly used as a masculine given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama diri yang berasal daripada bahasa Inggeris dan lazim digunakan sebagai nama lelaki.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，此处按可用枚举归入 noun。名字和姓氏须结合完整姓名区分。输入没有 DBP 释义，本项为人名说明；status 依指定模板保留，不代表已核实 DBP 收录。例句中的 Wesley 为示例人物。名字用法及读音：[Wiktionary：Wesley](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wesley)。

senses.zh_definition: 卫斯理／韦斯利：英语姓氏，如约翰·卫斯理和查尔斯·卫斯理的姓。
senses.en_definition: An English habitational surname, borne by John Wesley and Charles Wesley, among others.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang berasal daripada nama tempat, antaranya digunakan oleh John Wesley dan Charles Wesley.
senses.nuances: 中文译名依人物及既有传统而定；卫理宗历史人物常译作“卫斯理”。姓氏本身不等于宗教身份，也不能据此判断某个人的信仰。姓氏来源：[Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 提供](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/wesley)。历史人物：[英国卫理公会](https://www.methodist.org.uk/about/what-is-distinctive-about-methodism/born-in-song/)。

etymology.historical_story: Wesley began as an English surname associated with places such as Westley and Westleigh. Its historical elements are Old English west and lēah, referring to a wood or woodland clearing. The surname later became a given name. John and Charles Wesley also made the name prominent in Methodist history, without making it an exclusively religious personal name. [Surname history](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/wesley), [Given-name usage](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wesley), [Methodist history](https://www.methodist.org.uk/about/what-is-distinctive-about-methodism/born-in-song/)
